Happy new year my Loyal followers!

I wanted to let you know that I am starting my own Patreon this month!
So for those interested in 3D-printable models in the setting of Grim dark Technology enthusiasts that live in a heretical lifetime! Be sure to join my Patreon; Realm of Gears miniatures! https://www.patreon.com/RealmofGearsMiniatures

If you like what I’ve designed in the past, I’m about to make it my business full time!
Be sure to check it out!
To help you on the way, here is a freebie of Januari’s release!
I am proud to present; The Caedus-pattern Combat Cyborg!

I’ve included pictures of the full squad and all its options to be found in the full release on my Patreon!
There is even a PDF with experimental rules that I would LOVE to get some feedback on!
In the future I hope we’ll set-up a Discord to discuss this sort of thing!

All my models are always PRESUPPORTED and test printed!
